messages:
sam: quick sync on envelope migration + quota routing impact. main ask: ensure quota windows and console totals stay correct during dual-write.
anya: Agree. We must treat quota-aggregates as source-of-truth tolerant: dual-write should increment both stores atomically-ish.
rohan: Proposed approach: write-to-both, emit a small ack event with write_ids, then reconciliation compares write_ids per-route.
mike: ack events ok but extra index cost. Alternate: append a `write_tag` + deterministic route_hash and calculate deltas via projection job. Keep projection narrow.
jess: Console needs a per-tenant "quota_delta" widget so SRE/product can see if billing deviates. Show v1_total, v2_total, delta_pct.
sam: Gate criteria: for any tenant with >5000 tokens/day, delta_pct must be <0.5% for 48h before moving to 50% traffic.
anya: Rollback: flip read adapter, disable dual-write, run reconcile job with `--since` safepoint. Add alert to #support if any tenant delta_pct>2%.
rohan: Sample reconcile SQL to include in runbook: ```sql
SELECT tenant_id, sum(case when ingest_version='v1' then tokens else 0 end) v1_tokens,
       sum(case when ingest_version='v2' then tokens else 0 end) v2_tokens,
       100.0*(v2_tokens - v1_tokens)/greatest(1,v1_tokens) AS delta_pct
FROM ingestion_events
WHERE day >= current_date - interval '2 days'
GROUP BY tenant_id
HAVING greatest(v1_tokens,v2_tokens) > 1000;
```
mike: Projection DDL prototype: `CREATE TABLE ingest_projection (tenant_id text, route_id text, day date, v2_tokens bigint, v1_tokens bigint, primary key(tenant_id, route_id, day));` Add TTL for 30 days.
jess: UI will surface a banner during canary and a per-tenant quick link to reconciliation details.
ingest-bot: automated: shadow-write job will start at 2024-06-10T03:00Z when flags enabled :gear:
sam: ok owners: Mike projection SQL + runbook snippets, Rohan rollout gating, Jess console widgets, Anya runbook + support notif. I'll open the PR with the checklist later today.
anya: small nit: ensure sampling rules never drop high-volume tenants from telemetry.
rohan: will add deterministic include for tenants with daily >10k tokens.
sam: thanks. tagging this thread for follow-up.
